Part I:.Detail：: Use of temporary followspot, bubble machine and portable LED video panel for variety performance.

[NULL1].Description of Action Any particular Saf: Manual followspot tracking lead performer. Installed by registered electrician; WR1 submitted; dedicated 16A supply with RCD; cabling managed overhead and secured; trained operator at FOH; pre-show function test and visual inspection.

Strobe accents during choruses. Audience warned via programme and foyer notices; fixtures clamped with secondary safety bonds; DMX intensity and rate limited; supply via RCD; operator on headset; maximum 8 Hz per venue policy.
